title: Repair and Emergency Service Calls: Member Premium Discount Amount on After-Hours Calls
content:
**Comfort Club member credit note.** A Comfort Club member whose agreement is active on the completion date of an Evening, Weekend, Overnight Emergency or Holiday Emergency call under Repair and Emergency Service Calls receives a member premium discount on the after-hours premium of that call. A customer without an active agreement receives no member premium discount.

**Member premium percentage.** The member premium percentage is the after-hours premium discount percentage of the member's Comfort Club tier. On a Holiday Emergency call it is the tier's holiday premium discount percentage instead. The member premium percentage never exceeds 100 percent.

**Amount.** The member premium discount on an after-hours call is the after-hours premium billed on the call multiplied by the member premium percentage, rounded once to the cent half up. An amount that falls exactly halfway between two cents is rounded up to the higher cent; for this purpose an amount within 1e-09 of a dollar below the half cent counts as exactly halfway.

**Posting.** It is posted as one member premium discount line naming the premium line and the agreement.

## Inputs

| Input | Read from |
|---|---|
| Agreement active on the completion date | The member's Comfort Club agreement record |
| Call class | The call record |
| After-hours premium billed | The after-hours premium line on the call's invoice |
| Member premium percentage | The tier's after-hours premium discount percentage, or holiday premium discount percentage on a Holiday Emergency call |

## Worked examples (hypothetical calls, illustrative tier percentages)

| Call | Premium billed | Tier percentage that applies | Member premium discount |
|---|---|---|---|
| Evening Service Call | $99.00 | After-hours, 50 percent | $49.50 |
| Weekend Service Call | $119.00 | After-hours, 50 percent | $59.50 |
| Holiday Emergency Service Call | $249.00 | Holiday, 25 percent | $62.25 |
| Overnight Emergency Service Call | $189.00 | After-hours, 100 percent | $189.00 |
| Evening Service Call, agreement lapsed | $99.00 | — | None |
